messages.text: Autumn's Clear Skies and Evening Stars
A mostly clear autumn day offers mild temperatures and a chance to see the Draconids meteor shower. Local events include theater and music performances in nearby cities.
Today will be mostly clear with a high near 70°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:39 AM and sunset is at 7:03 PM, under a waning crescent moon 6.6% illuminated.

In Ypsilanti, EMU Theatre presents 'Metamorphoses' at the Sponberg Theatre at 7:00 PM. For music lovers, Ann Arbor's North Star Lounge hosts a free happy hour concert with Jordan Blanchard at 5:30 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12.

Several Michigan initiatives are set to receive significant funding. The Lenawee Now Foundation and Target Alpena Development Corporation will each receive $1.5 million for workforce development and housing, respectively.
Looking Ahead: Art, Music, and History
Tomorrow, catch the 'If Stones Could Talk' cemetery tours in Northville starting at 5:00 PM, or enjoy live music from Scythian at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM.

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review.
The next Starship launch estimate is no earlier than September 18, 2026.
The clear night sky offers a quiet invitation to look up.
